modern: Revere what is best in the universe; and this is what makes use of all things and directs all things. And in the same way also revere what is best in yourself; and this is of the same kind as that. For in you too, what makes use of everything else is this, and your life is directed by this.

explained.summary: Revere the best thing in the universe, the reason that orders and uses everything. Then revere the best thing in yourself, which is the same kind of thing: your own reason, which uses everything else in you and steers your life. Marcus sees your mind as a small share of the mind behind the whole.
